svg.title: Silk Road AI
svg.desc: Silk Road AI logo, flat-color variant for sub-48px renders where gradients alias. Navy mark with prominent navy anchor ball, sky-blue accent ball at the top-right of the silk-thread S-curve. Navy "Silk Road" wordmark, sky-blue "AI". W7 D4 PR-MN: anchor balls re-sized + cyan ball moved to the actual path terminus to match the original brand PNG.

g.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'PingFang SC', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
